transcript.text: roomba e5 wont charge properly, sometimes it does sometimes it doesnt

From what you have described, the most likely cause is the battery or charger. Check the charger is plugged into a working socket and fully into the vacuum (or the robot is seated on its dock), and wipe the charging contacts clean and dry. Was the charger, socket or contacts the problem (and is it sorted), does the charging light never come on, or is the charger fine with the light on?
Light on the base comes on when it docks. The contacts were dirty so I wiped them and it's charged 4 nights running now. Is that it?
Good news, that has sorted it. If it happens again, start with the same check. Is there anything else I can help with?
